text:
max: :rotating_light: seeing a big spike in 5xx + timeouts on hosted inference (/v1/generate) since 09:12 UTC. Error rate ~12% over 5m, lots of customer reports. logs show memcached prefix connect timeouts and gateway 502/504s.

tina: which region/route? any recent deploys or config changes? can you paste an example error payload?

max: ap-southeast-1 primarily, also some cross-region spill. sample error from gateway: `HTTP 504 - upstream request timed out (kv prefix fetch)`

leo: looking at metrics — memcached p95 latency jumped from 8ms -> 250ms around 09:11. connection errors and retransmits up. cache hit-rate dropped for high-traffic prefixes (prompt-prefix:v2-*).

infra-oncall: pulling memcached cluster health now. one node showing OOM/eviction churn and high CPU (98%). network peers show transient TCP retransmits. not yet clear if it's hardware or config.

support-bot: Notifying status page and tagging incidents channel. customers impacted: 7 orgs flagged via support inbox.

elaine: any recent TTL or prefix changes? we rolled the shorter prefix_ttl experiment last night for latency improvements, could be causing key churn.

max: yes — team deployed prefix_ttl=10s -> was 60s at 02:00 UTC. rollout ID: rollout-2026-03-16-prefix-thin. might correlate.

leo: plausible explanation: shorter TTL increases cache churn, causing thundering when many requests recompute/write to backend and saturate memcached connections. also saw increased backend RPCs to model-serving.

infra-oncall: mitigation idea: 1) rollback prefix_ttl to 60s, 2) temporarily route high-QPS customers to dedicated capacity or hit-through bypass. applying rollback now.

max: repro steps for support/eng to validate:
```bash
# reproduce hot path (non-prod example)
for i in {1..200}; do \
  curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood-dev/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TEST' -d '{"prompt":"hotkey-$i","max_tokens":8}' &
done
wait
# watch gateway logs for 502/504 and memcached timeouts
```

tina: thanks — running that in staging shows similar memcached conn timeouts after ~80 concurrent threads.

infra-oncall: rollback applied at 09:23 UTC (rollback id: rb-2582001111-1). restarted memcached pod on node-7, increased connection pool to 4096 for the cluster.

leo: after rollback and restart, p95 memcached latency back to ~10ms and API 5xx dropped to ~0.6% in last 3m. continuing to monitor.

max: sending customer updates now. opening incident ticket INC-2026-032-58 and assigning postmortem to eng-runtime + eng-ml (root cause likely prefix_ttl experiment causing cache churn + memcached capacity limits).

elaine: follow-up action items: - revert short TTL experiment permanently for hosted API until we can autoscale memcached and add hotspot protection - add guardrail on prefix_ttl rollouts (canary + traffic shaping) - add throttling on cache fill for hotspot prefixes.

support-bot: Created INC-2026-032-58 and linked support cases. will auto-update when status changes. :thumbsup:

max: thanks everyone. will post a short incident summary to #incidents once stable.
